title: Convert Comments to List
description: Convert the vertical list of comments into a single-line Python list named 'fruits'.
tips:
1a. Select all the comments .
2a. Remove comments with s#<enter> and delete it and the whitespace dd 
1b. Create multi cursor on all comments with C 
2b. Uncomment the lines with Ctrl-c 
3. Surround words with quotes w then ms".
4. Join everything into one line using J.
5. Replace spaces with commas x then s<space><enter> then c,<space> .
6. Surround with brackets using x then ms[ .
7. Jump to start of line using gh then add fruits = in front
